artist.name: Pagal Sound
artist.bio: Pagal Sound is a Delhi reggae selector linked to Pagal Records, a record store in Hauz Khas Village. He played all-vinyl roots reggae, dancehall and dub on boxout.fm from 2017, on WAXOUT and his own show Pagal Records, and played the reggae and dub session at Boxout Weekender in April 2018.

eras.sound: Roots reggae, dancehall and dub on vinyl
